visual_baseline: Preserved Quiet Material v0.7; founder-supplied screenshot for the exact opening
founder_constraint: Retain existing visual direction. Audit and complete its design system and cohesive gradients/atmospheric images. Instrument and Fieldwork rejected.

areas.acceptance: All current image tokens resolve to versioned records; missing reference/illustration sources located or explicitly unavailable.
Written, visual and structured recipes agree, including verification, closing CTA and Mineral inverse surfaces.
Existing S lockup and legacy compass are separated; navigation/avatar/favicon/inverse exports reference one chosen master.
Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono have exact files/licences, role specimens, numerals/glyphs and channel fallbacks.
All fourteen retained masters have contextual pairings, focal/crop records and reviewed uses; no speculative expansion.
Nine gradient roles mapped to permitted uses, surfaces and state distinctions; contextual contrast measured.
Needed control/navigation states rendered and tested, including keyboard, loading, disabled, error and empty.
Current glyph and illustration sources inventoried; functional diagram vs decorative raster rules unambiguous.
Named open, compact and framed patterns preserve hierarchy; copy slots optional; mobile and long-content specimens pass.
Timings/easing as shared data; supported modes explicit; pause, off-screen, reduced-motion/static equivalents tested.
Website, social/avatar/banner/OG, blog, email and document examples have source masters and reviewed exports; video has storyboard/poster/caption rules.
Asset reference/status checks, generated-view drift and actual apps/web/channel consumers covered by appropriate deterministic and visual checks.
